title: Enhanced diffusion sampling: Efficient rare event sampling and free energy calculation with diffusion models.
authors: Xie, Yu; Winkler, Ludwig; Sun, Lixin; Lewis, Sarah; Foster, Adam E; Jimenez Luna, Jose; Hempel, Tim; Gastegger, Michael; Chen, Yaoyi; Zaporozhets, Iryna; Clementi, Cecilia; Bishop, Christopher M; Noe, Frank
one_liner_zh: 该文提出增强扩散采样框架，结合扩散模型与偏置采样/重加权实现稀有事件高效采样和自由能计算，并应用于蛋白质折叠自由能预测，核心贡献在蛋白质构象采样与自由能计算，方法创新性强。
abstract: The rare-event sampling problem has long been the central limiting factor in molecular dynamics, especially in biomolecular simulation. Recently, diffusion models such as BioEmu have emerged as powerful equilibrium samplers that generate independent samples from complex molecular distributions, eliminating the cost of sampling rare transition events. However, a sampling problem remains when computing observables that rely on states which are rare in equilibrium, for example, folding free energies. Here, we introduce enhanced diffusion sampling, enabling efficient exploration of rare-event regions while preserving unbiased thermodynamic estimators. The key idea is to perform quantitatively accurate steering protocols to generate biased ensembles and subsequently recover equilibrium statistics via exact reweighting. We instantiate our framework in three algorithms: UmbrellaDiff (umbrella sampling with diffusion models), MetaDiff (a batchwise analog for metadynamics), and DeltaG-Diff (free-energy differences via tilted ensembles). We demonstrate the three methods on toy free-energy landscapes and apply DeltaG-Diff to protein folding free-energy calculations with BioEmu. Our methods reduce the cost of rare-state estimation, enabling protein folding free-energy calculations in minutes to hours of graphics processing unit time per system.
abstract_zh: 稀有事件采样问题长期以来一直是分子动力学中的核心限制因素，尤其是在生物分子模拟中。近年来，诸如BioEmu等扩散模型已成为强大的平衡采样器，能够从复杂分子分布中生成独立样本，从而消除了采样稀有转变事件的成本。然而，在计算依赖于平衡态中稀有状态的观测量（例如折叠自由能）时，采样问题仍然存在。在此，我们引入了增强扩散采样，能够高效探索稀有事件区域，同时保持无偏的热力学估计量。关键思想是执行定量精确的引导协议以生成偏置系综，随后通过精确重加权恢复平衡统计。我们将该框架实例化为三种算法：UmbrellaDiff（基于扩散模型的伞形采样）、MetaDiff（元动力学的批量模拟）以及DeltaG-Diff（通过倾斜系综计算自由能差）。我们在玩具自由能景观上演示了这三种方法，并将DeltaG-Diff应用于基于BioEmu的蛋白质折叠自由能计算。我们的方法降低了稀有状态估计的成本，使蛋白质折叠自由能计算在每系统几分钟到几小时的图形处理单元时间内即可完成。
